crossRefs.note: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…

translations.web: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
translations.bsb: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
translations.kjv: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
translations.asv: I hate and abhor falsehood; But thy law do I love.
